theories.name: 1. FEAR CONTRARIAN
theories.thesis: When market_fear sentiment is extremely negative, go LONG on quality assets

theories.name: 2. MOMENTUM FOLLOW
theories.thesis: When bitcoin news is bullish, ride the momentum across top alts

theories.name: 3. REGULATION HEDGE
theories.thesis: Negative crypto regulation news = SHORT altcoins, LONG BTC (flight to safety)

theories.name: 4. AI NARRATIVE PLAY
theories.thesis: Positive AI news benefits AI-adjacent crypto tokens

theories.name: 5. FED RATE SENSITIVITY
theories.thesis: Hawkish Fed news = SHORT crypto, Dovish = LONG crypto

theories.name: 6. DEFI MOMENTUM
theories.thesis: Positive DeFi news = LONG DeFi blue chips

theories.name: 7. INFLATION HEDGE
theories.thesis: High inflation news = LONG BTC + GOLD equivalent crypto

theories.name: 8. ALTCOIN ROTATION
theories.thesis: When altcoin news is bullish but BTC neutral, alts outperform

theories.name: 9. FEAR+FOREX CARRY
theories.thesis: Dollar weakness (negative forex USD news) = LONG crypto

theories.name: 10. NEWS REVERSAL (Contrarian)
theories.thesis: Extreme negative ALL topics = maximum contrarian LONG
